svg.aria-label: Original statement of Exercise 2.1.35. View u,v in ℝⁿ as n × 1 matrices. The scalar (inner) product uᵀv is a 1 × 1 matrix, usually written as a real number. The outer product uvᵀ is an n × n matrix.
